subject: BrightPath acquisition — remit routing consolidation & cutover playbook
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightpath.io>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@brightpath.io
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Remit routing for BrightPath + AP contact after close

Hi Connor / Marissa / Neha,

As we prepare to close the BrightPath acquisition (target cutover 2026-09-01), AP is trying to consolidate where Redwood invoices should be remitted and how to label invoices for easy reconciliation with our new ledger. A couple quick asks: 

- Can you confirm the remit address and AP email we should use for the consolidated BrightPath parent entity?
- Do you support an alternate remit (escrow agent) for the first 90 days while internal banking is rationalized?
- What invoice field should include the BrightPath PO / internal project code so our AR team can auto-apply payments?

Attached is BrightPath's initial AP contact list for your reference. If helpful, we can schedule 30 mins this week to walk through a proposed mapping.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee
Director, Finance Operations
BrightPath Software
[Attachment: bp_ap_contacts_v1.csv (text/csv)]
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightpath.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Remit routing for BrightPath + AP contact after close

Thanks Sam — good to get this ahead of the close. Quick summary of what we can support and a proposed cutover approach: 

1) Remit destinations 
   - Primary (post-cutover): Redwood Inference / BrightPath Ledger 
     remit@invoices.redwood.com (AP inbox)
     Mailing: Redwood Inference, Attn: Billing Ops — BrightPath Ledger, 210 Market St, SF, CA 94105

   - Temporary (escrow agent — recommended for first 60–90 days): Atlas Escrow (details below)

2) Invoice metadata (please ask your AP to include these fields on the PO/invoice):
   - External PO: BRP-<PO#> (prefix BrightPath)
   - Entity: BrightPath Software (HoldingCo) — use legal entity name in the invoice header
   - GL/Project: use "BRP-LEDGER" as the ledger tag for automated posting

3) Effective date and billing window
   - Proposed effective cutover: 2026-09-01 00:00 UTC. Invoices dated on/after 2026-09-01 should use the primary remit.
   - Any invoices dated prior should continue to remit to pre-close instructions.

4) Tax/VAT handling
   - For US invoices, standard sales tax rules apply by state; Redwood will not apply VAT on US-sourced invoices. If BrightPath EU entity requires VAT handling, we will coordinate a separate EU remit (please flag those AP contacts).

I've attached a small "remit matrix" that maps invoice types to remit destinations and sample invoice header text. Can you confirm AP will accept remit@invoices.redwood.com as the primary mailbox and let us know if we need to issue a pilot invoice to the escrow address?

Action items: 
- Sam: confirm primary AP email + whether escrow needed on day 1
- Marissa/Neha: review remit_matrix and confirm Redwood's internal GL tag for BrightPath (I'll expect Marissa to confirm by Monday)

Attachments: remit_matrix_brightpath.xlsx

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Accounts Lead, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath acquisition — remit routing consolidation & cutover playbook

Connor / Neha — reviewed the remit matrix. A few notes from finance/tax: 

- GL tag: we'll use BRP-LEDGER-2026 as the prefix (applied to invoice line item 9999). Works with our ERP import.
- Escrow handling: Atlas Escrow is fine for initial collections, but we need a signed MPA (third-party collections addendum) and the escrow bank details at least 7 business days before first pilot invoice.
- AP contacts: please ask BrightPath to provide a single functional AP mailbox (preferably remit@brightpath.io) + 1 escalation name/phone. We cannot rely on generic group inboxes for automated posting.

I've attached the sanitized AP contacts I pulled from HubSpot for Inventory — please ask Sam to confirm the final list and the single remit mailbox.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ap-contacts.csv (text/csv)]
From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@atlasescrow.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Atlas Escrow details + MPA redline

Hi Connor / Marissa / Neha,

Thanks for the heads up. Per our conversation, Atlas can accept invoice receipts and hold funds for a defined window while BrightPath finalizes banking consolidation. Attached is: 
- our bank account detail (wire/instructions)
- a short MPA redline for the escrow arrangement (signed by our legal team)

Please note: we require the signed MPA and a list of allowed payables (invoice numbers + vendor IDs) before we release funds to Redwood. Typical SLA: 5 business days for release after reconciliation.

Attachment: signed-mpa-redline.pdf

Best,
Marco Ruiz
VP, Client Escrow Services
Atlas Escrow LLC
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightpath.io>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, accounts-payable@brightpath.io
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath acquisition — remit routing consolidation & cutover playbook

Connor / team — confirmed on our side: 

- Primary AP mailbox post-close: remit@brightpath.io (will forward to our ERP intake team)
- Escrow: yes, please start with Atlas Escrow for first 60 days and then auto-switch to Redwood remit on 2026-11-01 (we'll confirm earlier if internal banking is ready)
- BrightPath will include PO prefix BRP- on all POs and send a pilot invoice dated 2026-09-02 to remit@invoices.redwood.com and CC Atlas (m.ruiz@atlasescrow.com) so we can test reconciliation and release behavior.

I've started the DocuSign for the MPA — link below. I'll follow up once our AP confirms the final remit mailbox routing rules.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=9a8b7c6d

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Sam
Samantha Lee
Director, Finance Operations
BrightPath Software
